rule: median craft score within 1 of the exemplar, and a memorable moment named by most critics, in every trial

per.memorable: the scan line sweeping the forecast and the sailable windows lighting up behind it
the scan line sweeping the forecast and turning the good wind hours amber behind it
the scrub line sweeping across the hours and the wind bars turning amber behind it
the scan line lighting up the windows

corrections.problem: the loop resets by fading the entire card to a near blank frame, which reads as a cut and throws away the reader's place
corrections.change: reset in place: roll the status back to 'Ready to check', fade the amber bars and windows out with the chart frame held still
corrections.keep: the 6s hold on the finished plan before the reset

corrections.where: A 9.50s to 10.50s, the proposed plan row
corrections.problem: the plan appears by growing the card taller, so the layout shifts under the windows just as they land
corrections.change: reserve the plan row's height from the start (placeholder or dimmed values) and fill it in place
corrections.keep: plan arriving after the windows, about 0.5s later

corrections.problem: cursor wanders across the chart for almost a second before the press, drawing the eye away from the chart
corrections.change: start the cursor near the button and press within 0.4s of the reset settling
corrections.keep: the visible press on 'Find windows' as the cause of everything after

corrections.where: A 8.30s to 9.60s, scan line and wind bars
corrections.problem: bars, stream, windows and status all change during the sweep, so no single thing owns the screen
corrections.change: let the scan own the sweep, then land the out window, then the back window, about 0.1s apart
corrections.keep: the scan line moving left to right in time

per.memorable: the scan line turning wind bars amber

corrections.problem: loop resets by fading the entire card to near white and back, a cut disguised as a dissolve
corrections.change: reset in place: amber bars fade to gray, windows retract, status rolls back to 'Ready to check', staggered 0.1s, about 0.5s total
corrections.keep: the cursor then travelling to Find windows

corrections.problem: scan, bar fill, Out window, Back window and status all change within about 1.2s so no single change is watched
corrections.change: let the scan finish first, then land Out, then Back 0.1s later, then roll the status to '2 windows found', and slow the scan to about 1.5s
corrections.keep: bars turning amber exactly as the scan line passes them

corrections.problem: the cursor is tiny and the press has little feedback before the button text swaps
corrections.change: add a clear press state (scale 0.97 for 100ms) and hold 'Checking' for the length of the scan
corrections.keep: the button label changing in place rather than a spinner

per.memorable: the scrub line passing over the hours as the bars turn amber

corrections.problem: the card washes out to a near-blank frame and rebuilds, which reads as a cut and throws away the result
corrections.change: reset in place: clear the windows and plan rows (0.2s, bottom up) and return bars to grey while the card frame, chart and labels stay put
corrections.keep: the 6s hold on the finished result before the reset

corrections.problem: cursor drifts in from the lower right for about 0.7s before the click; the eye follows the arrow, not the product
corrections.change: start the cursor near the button and click by 7.3s, or drop the cursor and press the button itself
corrections.keep: the button press as the trigger for the sweep

corrections.where: A 8.50s to 9.50s, scrub line and status
corrections.problem: status label, button label, sweep line and bar colours all change at once; no single owner
corrections.change: let the sweep own the screen; change the status label 0.1s after the sweep ends, not during it
corrections.keep: the bars turning amber as the line passes them

corrections.where: A 9.50s to 10.50s, Out, Back and plan rows
corrections.problem: windows and the plan row arrive within about 1s of each other, so the plan times are read while windows are still landing
corrections.change: hold the found windows 1s before the plan row comes in, rows offset by 0.1s
corrections.keep: the in-place 'Not checked' to 'Leave 07:33 to 09:30' change

per.memorable: the window end time rolling back and a hatched slice appearing on the bar

corrections.problem: the old forecast, window end 13:45 and 'Plan saved' are visible for under a second, so the viewer never reads what is about to change
corrections.change: hold the before state at least 2.5s, ideally with the 13:45 end time in a resting focus
corrections.keep: the in-place digit rolls and the 0.1s cascade

corrections.problem: the hatched slice is about 6px wide and is the actual news, but it is the smallest thing that moves
corrections.change: animate the window's right edge retracting from 13:45 to 13:20 over 0.4s with a landing ease, leaving the hatch behind
corrections.keep: the hatch pattern as the record of the lost time

corrections.problem: the old notification empties to a blank card before the new text appears, a visible gap
corrections.change: cross the texts in place (old out up, new in from below) with no empty frame
corrections.keep: the notification arriving last as the explanation

corrections.problem: everything is over by 1.4s and the remaining 10s are static, so the climax is crammed at the start
corrections.change: place the change after a 2.5s read and hold the result about 4s, then loop
corrections.keep: the long readable hold on the explanatory notification

per.memorable: the return window shrinking and leaving a hatched sliver where the lost 25 minutes were

corrections.problem: old message disappears and the card sits empty before the new one fades in
corrections.change: cross-roll the text in place, or slide the new notification over the old with no empty frame
corrections.keep: the notification arriving last, after the window has moved

corrections.where: B 0.80s to 1.20s, forecast label, window time, bar and 15:25 row
corrections.problem: four changes land in about 0.4s, faster than they can be followed
corrections.change: spread the chain over about 1.2s: forecast label, pause 0.3s, window bar shrink, then the Leave time and the 15:00 row 0.1s apart
corrections.keep: the order cause first (new forecast) then effect (window shortens)

corrections.problem: the highlight that signals a new forecast is faint and brief
corrections.change: hold the highlighted tag 0.4s before the time rolls so the viewer knows why the window moves
corrections.keep: the amber tint as the only accent besides the brand pink

per.memorable: the window bar shrinking and its lost slice turning hatched

corrections.where: B 0.86s to 1.46s, cause and effect order
corrections.problem: the data changes first and the notification that explains it arrives last, so the viewer sees numbers move with no reason, then reads the reason
corrections.change: land the 'Back window moved' notification first, hold it 1s, then roll the forecast label, the end time and the bar in that order
corrections.keep: the vertical digit rolls and the hatched lost slice

corrections.problem: the card blanks to empty white for a frame before the new message fades in: a cut inside a card
corrections.change: crossfade the old text out and the new text in with 0.1s overlap, card never empty
corrections.keep: the card's position and size

corrections.where: B 0.86s to 1.10s, label, time, bar and rows
corrections.problem: four related changes fire within about 0.25s, too fast to follow the chain from forecast to window
corrections.change: space them about 0.15s apart and give the bar shrink 0.4s with an ease-out that lands
corrections.keep: everything changing in place, no layout shift

corrections.problem: about 10.5s of static hold; nothing points the eye to the new 13:20 or the 'Your 12:30 start still works' line
corrections.change: after 1.5s of hold, briefly highlight the 12:30 start on the bar to answer 'am I still OK', then rest
corrections.keep: the long hold on readable text

per.memorable: the boat drawing the route to Cowes as the distance ticks up

corrections.problem: the reset fades the card to a fully blank frame, a cut that loses the map and the reader's place
corrections.change: keep the map still and retract the route line back to Lymington in place, resetting the readout with a roll
corrections.keep: the long hold on the arrival before the reset

corrections.problem: values fade out and in, leaving a beat where the label is blank and the number is ghosted
corrections.change: roll the digits in place (09:17 to 09:59, 4.6 to 9.2 nm) so the number is never absent
corrections.keep: the label leading the value by about 0.1s

corrections.problem: the line and the dot move at near constant speed and stop at each waypoint without settling
corrections.change: ease each leg out so the dot decelerates into the waypoint, with a small settle on arrival at Cowes as the climax
corrections.keep: the leg-by-leg pacing of about 2s per leg

corrections.problem: arrival changes only the readout colour; the climax is no bigger than the waypoints before it
corrections.change: mark arrival once: the Cowes pin fills and the 10:10 lands a beat after, with the rest held still
corrections.keep: the magenta arrival time and the restraint of a single accent

per.memorable: the route drawing across the Solent waypoint by waypoint

corrections.problem: the card fades out to a blank frame and back, which reads as a cut
corrections.change: reset in place: retract the solid route back to dashed in 0.5s while the stats roll down to 0.0, with no blank frame
corrections.keep: the dashed route and Leave 08:30 start state

corrections.problem: the waypoint label fades to nothing before the new one appears, so the readout blinks
corrections.change: roll the label, time, distance and speed in place, 0.05s apart, no empty state
corrections.keep: the stats updating exactly when the dot reaches each waypoint

corrections.problem: arrival is the climax but looks the same as the earlier waypoints
corrections.change: give Arrive Cowes 10:10 a single settle (dot scale 1.0 to 1.3 to 1.0 over 300ms, time in brand color) and hold it 3s
corrections.keep: the restrained map with no decorative motion

per.memorable: the dot sailing the route as the distance and arrival time tick up

corrections.problem: card fades to a blank frame at 10.08s then reappears at the start state: a cut that drops the map and the result
corrections.change: keep the map and labels on screen; retract the drawn route back to Lymington over 0.5s and roll the readout back to 08:30 in place
corrections.keep: the 6s hold on 'Arrive Cowes 10:10'

corrections.where: A 1.00s to 2.00s, readout under the map
corrections.problem: the waypoint label and time cross-fade with both versions ghosted at 1.5s, and the readout changes while the dot is still moving
corrections.change: roll the readout values vertically at the moment the dot reaches each waypoint, 0.1s after arrival
corrections.keep: one readout row with three fixed columns

corrections.where: A 0.50s to 3.50s, dot travel between waypoints
corrections.problem: movement between waypoints looks constant speed and stops dead at each mark
corrections.change: ease in and out per leg (about 0.8s per leg) with a short settle at each waypoint
corrections.keep: the leg-by-leg order and the dashed line turning solid behind the dot

corrections.problem: the intermediate readout 'Gurnard 09:59' holds about 1.5s, short against three values to read
corrections.change: hold each intermediate readout at least 2s, or show only the arrival readout and let the map carry the progress
corrections.keep: the arrival time 10:10 in the accent colour
